name: Zephyr 7B Alpha

sources.locator: Hub repository HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-alpha, Files and versions

lifecycle.note: Weights are downloadable from the HuggingFaceH4 organisation on the Hub. Hugging Face publishes no deprecation page for its models.

sources.locator: Hub commit history: repository created 2023-10-09, model card written 2023-10-10

released.note: No dated announcement by Hugging Face was found, so only the month is recorded. The repository was created on 2023-10-09 and the model card written on 2023-10-10; the Zephyr 7B beta card of 2023-10-26 already compares with this model.

summary.text: Zephyr 7B Alpha is the first model in Hugging Face's Zephyr series of chat assistants, a 7B fine-tune of Mistral 7B v0.1 published as open weights under the MIT licence. Hugging Face says it removed the built-in alignment of its UltraChat and UltraFeedback training data, which made the model more helpful but also more likely to produce problematic text.

openWeights.note: MIT licence; the commit history shows the licence set to MIT on 2023-10-13.

notes: First model of the Zephyr series according to its model card; no predecessor relation recorded. Fine-tuned from Mistral AI's Mistral 7B v0.1; that cross-organisation relation is not recorded here. The card also uses the name Zephyr-7B-α.
